summary: Uninitialized local silently reaches arithmetic: dxc exits 0, emits 'i32 undef' as an IMad operand, no diagnostic. Reproduces in all 20 releases v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607. Maintainer's SV_Position variant behaves the same with float undef into FMad.
title: dxc silently passes uninitialized value as undef
